CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 17

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

4. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

5. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 11
   C. 8
   D. 7

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

7. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 7

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

10. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 122

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 12

13. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 29

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144

5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
